brief:
Iran's military spokesman Abolfazl Shakarpasand warned Saturday that any future Iranian response to American or Israeli aggression would differ markedly from previous retaliations, Shehab Wire reported. Shakarpasand cautioned both Washington and Tel Aviv against repeating what he characterized as past mistakes, suggesting a shift in Tehran's strategic posture.

The warning comes amid escalating regional tensions and follows earlier Iranian strikes on Israel. Iranian officials have previously signaled readiness to respond to further military action, though Shakarpasand's remarks suggest the nature of any such response may be fundamentally different from previous instances.

title: Iran warns U.S., Israel response will differ if attacks resume
